title: Cosmic Trivia
article:
1

What is the name of the theory that moving faster than light will cause you to go back in time?



The General relativity theory

The Ekpyrotic Universe theory

The Fermi Paradox

The Brahmanda theory



2

How did the Death Angels from the 2018 movie A Quiet Place come to earth?



A rogue planet

A wormhole

A asteroid

A Relativistic jet



3

Everything seen is from some moment in the the past



True

False



4

What TV show was aired from September 8, 1966 to June 3, 1969 on NBC?



Lost in space

The Expanse

The Orville

Star trek



5 Which planet's moon, Europa, is believed to have a subsurface ocean beneath its icy crust?

A) Saturn

B) Jupiter

C) Neptune

D) Uranus



6 What is the primary component of the Sun's mass?

A) Hydrogen

B) Oxygen

C) Helium

D) Carbon



7 What was the name of the spacecraft that first successfully landed on a comet in 2014?

A) Voyager 1

B) Rosetta

C) New Horizons

D) Cassini



8 Which planet has the longest day of any planet in the solar system?

A) Venus

B) Jupiter

C) Mercury

D) Neptune



9 What is the closest star to Earth, after the Sun?

A) Alpha Centauri A

B) Proxima Centauri

C) Sirius A

D) Barnard's Star



10 What phenomenon occurs when light from a star is stretched to longer wavelengths due to the expansion of the universe?

A) Gravitational lensing

B) Redshift

C) Blue shift

D) Cosmic microwave background



11 In 2020, the first interstellar object to pass through our solar system was detected. What was its name?

A) 1I/2017 U1

B) Oumuamua

C) C/2019 Q4

D) Asteroid 101955 Bennu



12 Which is the largest known volcano in the solar system?

A) Mount Everest

B) Mount Olympus (Olympus Mons)

C) Vesuvius

D) Mauna Loa

13 Which exoplanet, discovered in 2009, is considered one of the most Earth-like exoplanets found so far?

A) Kepler-452b

B) Kepler-186f

C) Proxima Centauri b

D) TRAPPIST-1d



14 What is the name of the largest moon of Neptune?

A) Triton

B) Ganymede

C) Callisto

D) Titan





Answers:

A) The General relativity theory

C) Asteroid

A) True

D) Star trek

B) Jupiter

A) Hydrogen

B) Rosetta

A) Venus

B) Proxima Centauri

B) Redshift

B) Oumuamua

B) Mount Olympus (Olympus Mons)

A) Kepler-452b

A) Triton
author: Maxwell Rothberger
